units.title: 谋差顶役：以官爻为主、世象为凭；书辩捕兵民皂卒谋差顶役世爻详，各忌六冲官害世、皆宜财鬼旺为强；一应衙门生意顶役谋差若遇六冲决难成就纵成不久，官鬼若伤身世终遭罪责难逃，得财官两旺其中定见兴家

rule.yi: 谋差使、顶替衙门的役，以官爻为主，以世爻为凭据。书办、捕快、兵、民壮、皂隶、差役这些人谋差顶役，要细看世爻；都忌六冲、官爻害世爻，都适宜财爻、官鬼旺相才强。凡是衙门里的差事、生意、顶役、谋差，如果遇到六冲，一定难以成就，即使成了也不长久；官鬼如果伤了身爻、世爻，终究遭到罪责，难以逃脱；得到财、官两旺在其中，一定见到兴家。
rule.en: In seeking a commission or taking over a post in a yamen's service, take the Pressure line as the chief and the Self image as the ground. For clerks, scribes, constables, soldiers, militiamen, lictors and runners seeking a commission or taking over a service, examine the Self line in detail; all fear a six-clash and the star of office harming the Self, and all are fitly strong when Wealth and Pressure are thriving. For every job in a yamen, whether a livelihood, taking over a service or seeking a commission, if it meets a six-clash it will surely be hard to accomplish, and even if it is accomplished it will not last; if Pressure injures the Body or the Self, one will in the end be blamed and punished and cannot escape; if Wealth and the star of office are both thriving within it, one will surely see the household prosper.

yi: 以官爻为主要看的，以世爻为凭据。
en: Take the Pressure line as the chief to be looked at, and the Self image as the ground.

zh: 书辩捕兵民皂卒，谋差顶役世爻详，
各忌六冲官害世，皆宜财鬼旺为强。
yi: 书办、捕快、兵、民壮、皂隶、差役，谋差使、顶替役位，要细看世爻；
都忌六冲、官爻害世；都适宜财爻、官鬼旺相才强。
en: For clerks, scribes, constables, soldiers, militiamen, lictors and runners, in seeking a commission or taking over a service, the Self line is examined in detail;
all fear a six-clash and the star of office harming the Self, and all are fitly strong when Wealth and Pressure are thriving.

zh: 一应衙门生意顶役谋差，若遇六冲决难成就，纵成不久。
官鬼若伤身世，终遭罪责难逃，得财官两旺其中，定见兴家。
yi: 凡是衙门里的生意、顶役、谋差，如果遇到六冲，一定难以成就，即使成了也不长久。
官鬼如果伤了身爻、世爻，终究遭到罪责，难以逃脱；得到财、官两旺在其中，一定见到兴家。
en: For every job in a yamen, whether a livelihood, taking over a service or seeking a commission, if it meets a six-clash it will surely be hard to accomplish, and even if it is accomplished it will not last.

If Pressure injures the Body or the Self, one will in the end be blamed and punished and cannot escape; if Wealth and the star of office are both thriving within it, one will surely see the household prosper.

note.yi: 这三章（第四十至四十二章）的章名在书里缺失，只留下小标；它们处在第三十九章（谋望成事）和第四十三章（除名脱役）之间，这里推定为第四十、四十一、四十二章，章名按内容拟：谋差顶役、户役、帮户。「书辩」疑是「书办」（衙门里的文书），「皂卒」是皂隶、差役，「顶役」是顶替别人的差役名额，「谋差」是谋求一个差使，「衙门生意」是在衙门里谋生的行当。「兴家」是家道兴旺。
note.en: The titles of these three chapters (Chapters 40 to 42) are missing in the book and only the subtitles remain; as they lie between Chapter 39 (scheming and accomplishing affairs) and Chapter 43 (removal from the rolls and release from service), they are taken here as Chapters 40, 41 and 42, with titles supplied from the content: seeking a commission or taking over a service post, household service, and sharing a household's service. 'Shu bian' is presumably 'shuban', clerks of a yamen; 'zaozu' are the lictors and runners; 'ding yi' is taking over another man's place in the service; 'mou chai' is seeking a commission; 'yamen shengyi' is a line of livelihood in a yamen. 'Xingjia' is the household prospering.

units.title: 谋差顶役：更愁身命随官墓、世坐空亡谁赞襄，无鬼莫来谋此役、官临身世却宜当；身世本命随官入墓祸不可当，世值空亡焉能久远，卦中无鬼所作不成纵成始终无益，若得官临身世本命又遇生扶宜充此役

rule.yi: 更怕身、命随着官爻入墓，世爻坐空亡，谁来帮助？没有官鬼，就不要来谋这份役；官爻临在身爻、世爻上，却适宜担当。具体说：身爻、世爻、本命随着官爻入墓，祸就挡不住；世爻落在空亡，哪能长久？卦中没有官鬼，所做的不成，即使成了也始终无益；如果官爻临在身爻、世爻上，本命又遇到生扶，就适宜充任这份役。
rule.en: Still more fear the Body and the fate following the star of office into the tomb, and with the Self sitting on Void who will assist? With no Pressure do not come to seek this service; with the star of office on the Body or the Self it is on the contrary fitting to take it up. In detail: if the Body, the Self and the native fate follow the star of office into the tomb, the calamity cannot be withstood; if the Self falls on Void, how can it last long? If the hexagram has no Pressure, what one does will not succeed, and even if it succeeds it is of no benefit from first to last; if the star of office rests on the Body or the Self and the native fate meets generation and support, it is fitting to fill this service.

zh: 更愁身命随官墓，世坐空亡谁赞襄，
无鬼莫来谋此役，官临身世却宜当。
yi: 更怕身、命随着官爻入墓，世爻坐空亡，谁来帮助？
没有官鬼，就不要来谋这份役；官临在身爻、世爻上，却适宜担当。
en: Still more fear the Body and the fate following the star of office into the tomb, and with the Self sitting on Void who will assist?
With no Pressure do not come to seek this service; with the star of office on the Body or the Self it is on the contrary fitting to take it up.

zh: 但若身世本命随官入墓，祸不可当。
卦中无鬼，所作不成，纵若成之，始终无益。
若得官临身世，本命又遇生扶，宜充此役。
yi: 但如果身爻、世爻、本命随着官爻入墓，祸就挡不住。
世爻落在空亡，哪能长久？
卦中没有官鬼，所做的不成；即使成了，也始终无益。
如果官爻临在身爻、世爻上，本命又遇到生扶，就适宜充任这份役。
en: But if the Body, the Self and the native fate follow the star of office into the tomb, the calamity cannot be withstood.
If the Self falls on Void, how can it last long?
If the hexagram has no Pressure, what one does will not succeed, and even if it succeeds it is of no benefit from first to last.
If the star of office rests on the Body or the Self and the native fate meets generation and support, it is fitting to fill this service.

note.yi: 「身命」「本命」按常例是身爻、世爻和问卜人的本命（出生年的地支）；书里没有再解释。「随官入墓」增删卜易另有说法（ZS.06）。「赞襄」是帮助。这一条与黄金策仕宦「官爻隐伏，莫思爵位升迁」（HJC.06）、「身空无救，命尽当危」（HJC.09）取同一类象：官爻不出现、世身落空都不成。
note.en: 'Shenming' and 'benming' are, by the usual practice, the Body and the Self lines and the native fate of the person asking (the branch of his birth year); the book does not explain them further. 'Following the star of office into the tomb' has another account in the Zengshan Buyi (ZS.06). 'Zanxiang' is helping. This entry takes the same kind of images as 'if the star of office lies hidden, do not think of rank and promotion' (HJC.06) and 'a Void Body without rescue means life is exhausted and in danger' (HJC.09) in the Huangjin Ce on official careers: with the star of office not appearing and the Self or Body Void, nothing comes of it.

units.title: 谋差顶役：财空鬼弱兄爻动但得虚名利不昌、世不逢冲官不绝差成役就乐欢肠；财落空中官居衰地事虽见就必主无财，卦中纵有衰财或逢兄动亦不为祥，世象不冲不破官爻不绝不空便言谋中得成求财得利

rule.yi: 财爻落空、官鬼衰弱、兄爻发动，只得到虚名，利益不旺；世爻不遇冲、官爻不绝，差使办成、役位到手，心里欢喜。财爻落在空中、官爻居衰地，事情虽看似成了，一定没有钱财；卦中即使有衰弱的财爻，或者遇到兄动，也不吉祥；世爻不冲不破、官爻不绝不空，就可以说谋求能成、求财得利。
rule.en: With Wealth Void, Pressure weak and the Peer line moving, one gets only an empty name and profit does not flourish; if the Self does not meet a clash and the star of office is not extinct, the commission is won and the service is taken up, and the heart is glad. If Wealth falls into Void and the star of office sits in a weak place, then although the matter seems to be accomplished there will surely be no money; even if there is a weak Wealth line in the hexagram, or Peer moves, it is not auspicious; if the Self image is not clashed or broken and the Pressure line is not extinct or Void, one may say that the scheme will succeed and that seeking wealth will bring gain.

zh: 财空鬼弱兄爻动，但得虚名利不昌，
世不逢冲官不绝，差成役就乐欢肠。
yi: 财爻落空、官鬼衰弱、兄爻发动，只得到虚名，利益不旺；
世爻不遇冲、官爻不绝，差使办成、役位到手，心里欢喜。
en: With Wealth Void, Pressure weak and the Peer line moving, one gets only an empty name and profit does not flourish;
if the Self does not meet a clash and the star of office is not extinct, the commission is won and the service is taken up, and the heart is glad.

zh: 财落空中官居衰地，事虽见就，必主无财，卦中纵有衰财或逢兄动，亦不为祥。
世象不冲不破，官爻不绝不空，便言谋中得成，求财得利。
yi: 财爻落在空中、官爻居衰地，事情虽看似成了，一定没有钱财；卦中即使有衰弱的财爻，或者遇到兄动，也不吉祥。
世爻不冲不破、官爻不绝不空，就可以说谋求能成、求财得利。
en: If Wealth falls into Void and the star of office sits in a weak place, then although the matter seems to be accomplished there will surely be no money; even if there is a weak Wealth line in the hexagram, or Peer moves, it is not auspicious.
If the Self image is not clashed or broken and the Pressure line is not extinct or Void, one may say that the scheme will succeed and that seeking wealth will bring gain.

note.yi: 这一条是谋差顶役一章的收尾：要有名（官）也要有利（财），财空鬼弱兄动是「有名无利」。「欢肠」是心里欢喜。
note.en: This entry closes the chapter on seeking a commission: one needs both name (the star of office) and profit (Wealth), and Wealth Void, Pressure weak and Peer moving is 'a name without profit'. 'Huanchang' is a glad heart.
